overview: The Committee approved restructuring the before and after school program waitlist into a lottery and accepted several donations for the science department. Updates were also provided on fine arts programming and the ongoing implementation of the Medford High School action plan.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The Committee entered executive session to discuss collective bargaining negotiations for administrators, custodians, and security monitors.

items.title: Superintendent's Update
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent recognized Disability Awareness and Women's History months, announced various student achievements in athletics and the arts, and noted the start of Ramadan.

items.title: Science Department Donations and Recognitions
items.summary: The Committee approved a $2,000 donation from Mabbitt and Associates and a $3,000 donation from the J.S. Lim Foundation before recognizing student participants in the Region 4 Science and Engineering Fair.

items.title: Visual and Performing Arts Presentation
items.summary: Coordinators provided an update on fine and performing arts activities, highlighting new art therapy internships, equipment upgrades, and upcoming musical performances.

items.title: Before and After School Program Update
items.summary: The Committee approved a motion to replace the waitlist with an on-demand lottery for incoming kindergartners and requested further financial analysis on a proposal to increase market tuition rates while keeping sliding scale rates flat.

items.title: Medford High School Action Plan Update
items.summary: The Superintendent presented data showing a significant decrease in class cutting and roaming since the introduction of new bathroom and hallway monitoring protocols.

items.title: Condolence
items.summary: The Committee expressed condolences to the family of Anthony A. Teixeira Jr. and observed a moment of silence.
